summary: The Model Data Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable infrastructure to support machine learning model training, experimentation, and deployment.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines for ML model input
Ensure data consistency, quality, and accessibility for training and inference
Implement infrastructure for model versioning, evaluation, and monitoring
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to improve workflows
Optimize storage, compute, and processing for AI datasets

education: 5–8 years of experience in ML infrastructure or AI data engineering
DevOps, Infrastructure & Reliability (Data) – Detailed Job Descriptions

skills_required.name: Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java
Knowledge of distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Hadoop)
Experience with MLOps, ML lifecycle tools, and feature stores
